Class Gastropoda > Family Cypraeidea Pear-shaped cowrie
Erronea pyriformis Family Cypraeidaeupdated Jul 2020

Where seen? This small cowrie has so far only been seen at Beting Bronok. It was previously known as Cypraea pyriformis. Features: About 2cm. Shell pear-shaped, generally pale blue with 3 broad pale brown bands, sometimes 1 band darker, or bands are broken up into squares. Underside pale with a few dark spots and small dark ‘teeth’. The living animal has a dark mottled mantle.
